text:
mike: quick thread to triage recurring incident themes from Oct-Dec and assign owners + measurable follow-ups. goal: reduce repeats by end of Q1.
priya: thanks, added rollup sheet to the ops deck (slide 5). numbers show clear hotspots.
dan: observed buckets: cache evictions, model OOMs with long sessions, tokenizer regressions, DB replica lag, and autoscaler instability.
linda: can we mark which are regressions vs long-standing? that affects priority.
sara: I flagged 42 incidents as recurring in the query; CSV on the doc.
incident-bot: compiled 42 items tagged "recurring" (2025-10-01..2025-12-31). top three: cache(28%), model-oom(19%), db-replica(16%).
mike: proposed ownership: cache->priya, model-oom->dan, db->alex, tokenizer->linda, autoscale->sara. confirm?
priya: confirmed. I'll create a remediation epic and link PMRs. tentative ETA for initial fixes: 2026-01-31.
dan: model OOM plan: pin model builds, add conservative quant profile, and run a 7-day long-session stress test on Dedicated. owner: dan. ETA 2026-01-20.
alex: DB plan: add read-fallback for replicas, lower stmt timeouts, improve replica lag alerts. ticket JIRA-9910 opened. ETA 2026-02-05.
linda: tokenizer plan: corpus fuzz tests + whitespace edge fix in tokenizer v4; integrate with CI. ticket JIRA-9915. ETA 2026-01-15.
sara: autoscaler: root cause points to burst policy + preemptions. short-term: cap shard growth, increase scale-down cooldown; add scaling-variance alert. I'll canary and monitor. ETA 2026-01-10.
priya: observability adds: per-route cache hit-rate, prefix-KV eviction metric, alert if eviction>5% in 5m. cc eng-sre for queries.
dan: interim mitigation: per-session soft token limits + graceful truncation to reduce OOMs.
mike: I'll add a canonical action table in the tracker (owners, tickets, ETAs, test plans). drop final ticket IDs by EOD Friday.
alex: JIRA-9910 linked.
linda: JIRA-9915 linked.
sara: will post canary schedule in #eng-oncall and tag oncall leads.
priya: scheduling follow-up sync two weeks after the last ETA: 2026-02-10 10:00 PST.
mike: target: 50% reduction in recurring incident count vs Q4 baseline by end of Q1. agree?
all: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: reminder set for 2026-02-10 10:00 PST (follow-up).
mike: thanks all, closing thread after I attach ticket links and calendar invite.
